meta.title: Your catalog has holes
meta.description: Missing costs, weights and codes hide money today and turn away AI shoppers tomorrow. One readiness score for your Shopify catalog, with every gap priced in dollars.

hero.headline: Your catalog has <accent>holes.</accent>
hero.subhead: Missing costs, weights, codes. <lead>Today they hide money.</lead> Tomorrow they turn away customers you’ll never even see.
hero.finePrint: Free scan · One readiness score · Gaps priced in dollars

score.label: Readiness Score
score.caption: Sample data — your report is built from your store.

today.label: TODAY
today.body: No cost on a third of SKUs means margin is a guess. No weights means shipping surprises. And every report you trust is built on those blanks — missing costs are the precondition for every margin number you’ll ever compute.

tomorrow.label: TOMORROW
tomorrow.body: AI shopping agents read your catalog raw — no photos, no vibes, just fields. Whatever is blank doesn’t exist to them. They’re already browsing, and you’ll never see the customers they turned away.

someday.title: “I’ve been meaning to clean it up someday.”
someday.sub: So has everyone — and the catalog grows faster than the someday ever comes. Nobody audits 400 products field by field. The blanks pile up quietly, and every report built on them is a guess.

report.title: Every gap, priced where it can be
report.sub: Not a checklist — a bill. The scan shows what each blank field is costing you, in dollars where the arithmetic allows.
report.caption: Sample data, labeled as such — we never invent case studies. Your report comes from your store.

how.title: From guessing to knowing, in three steps

scan.title: Scan
scan.body: Free score plus the full gap list — priced in dollars wherever the arithmetic allows.

enrich.title: Enrich
enrich.body: It fills every field that can be inferred; you approve. Nothing changes without your yes.

ready.title: Stay ready
ready.body: Every new product checked on upload. The score holds — forever, without you chasing it.

how.footer: Audit → approval → earned autonomy. This is how every Leaf app works.

cta.title: Run the free scan. See your score.
cta.sub: One list, every coming Leaf app — you’re first in line for all of them. Early merchants get a direct line to the founder and a say in what we build.
cta.offer: The first {spots, number} stores get the top plan at the middle plan’s price — locked for life.
